purpose: Teach: オペレーティングシステム/電機/アスキー/スペル/エフェクト/パワーアップ/ポチッ/メッセンジャー
target_vocab: オペレーティングシステム

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収端末のオペレーティングシステムを、警察、解析されますね
lines.en: The police department handles the analysis of seized devices' operating systems, doesn't it.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact recitation. Even pacing. Respectful but not deferential. Delivers each clause as straightforward fact, checking in lightly at the end with the particle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、電機工場での事案対応も担当されますね
lines.en: And the police also manage incident response at electrical facilities.
lines.style: Same steady rhythm. Slight nod of recognition in the delivery. No emphasis — just adding to the list. Warm acknowledgment without admiration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、文書のアスキーコードを、警察、復号されますね
lines.en: The police decode ASCII in documents as part of the investigation, I imagine.
lines.style: Continuing the measured tone. Light curiosity beneath the surface. Not quite asking, but inviting confirmation. Breath support steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内文書のスペル誤りも、警察、注意されますね
lines.en: You all are careful even with spelling errors in station records, aren't you.
lines.style: Slight warmth here — gentle observation of meticulousness. Appreciative undertone. Pace remains even. Almost admiring in its quietness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の動画のエフェクト解析もされますね
lines.en: And you analyze effects in suspect videos too, if I'm not mistaken.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact curiosity. Not challenging — genuinely impressed by the scope. Even delivery with a light lift at the end, checking if he's understood the range of work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査チームのパワーアップを、警察、計画されますね
lines.en: You're planning improvements to strengthen the investigation team.
lines.style: Acknowledging shift. Warmth rises slightly. Recognition of forward-thinking. Still respectful. Steady pace, slight emphasis on the effort involved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急ボタンを「ポチッ」と押す仕組みを、警察、整備されますね
lines.en: The emergency button system is set up for quick response, I see.
lines.style: Slight lightness touches the delivery here — the onomatopoeia 「ポチッ」 gives permission for a touch of gentle humor. Still respectful, but less formal. Easier breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民向けメッセンジャー通報も導入されますね
lines.en: And now you're rolling out a messaging system for citizens to report incidents directly.
lines.style: Shift to slightly closer, more intimate tone. The work has become personal somehow. Recognition of a bridge being built. Warm, present. A touch of genuine interest.
